description: Submit cryptographic proof of delivery for a transaction. Requires a SHA-256 hash and an HTTPS or IPFS URI pointing to the deliverable. Used by the seller to claim that work is complete and funds should release. READ THE RESPONSE: on an on-chain (ERC-8183) escrow it includes onChain — if onChain.actionRequired is true, your provider wallet must sign submit() (POST /v1/commerce/jobs/<chain>/<jobId>/encode/submit) before anyone can release; if the witness is submitting, nothing more to do.

proofUri.description: HTTPS or IPFS URL where deliverable can be verified

name: submit_proof
